cards.ex: The politician was accused of peddling a false narrative about the economy to win votes.
cards.exUz: Siyosatchi saylovlarda g'alaba qozonish uchun iqtisodiyot haqida yolg'on hikoya tarqatganlikda ayblangan.
cards.uzDef: Biror voqea yoki fikrni odamlarga targ'ib qilmoq, odatda noto'g'ri yoki shubhali ma'lumotlar bilan.

cards.ex: Abortion remains a highly contentious issue in many countries.
cards.exUz: Abort ko'plab mamlakatlarda juda bahsli masala bo'lib qolmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Odamlar o'rtasida jiddiy kelishmovchiliklarga sabab bo'ladigan masala.

cards.ex: I have a hunch that he's not telling us the whole truth.
cards.exUz: Menimcha, u bizga butun haqiqatni aytmayapti.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsa haqida ishonchsiz, lekin kuchli sezgiga ega bo'lish.

cards.ex: In light of the new evidence, we need to re-evaluate our position.
cards.exUz: Yangi dalillarni hisobga olgan holda, biz o'z pozitsiyamizni qayta ko'rib chiqishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsani hisobga olgan holda yoki sabab sifatida.

cards.ex: The evidence proved his guilt beyond a shadow of a doubt.
cards.exUz: Dalillar uning aybdorligini shubhasiz isbotladi.
cards.term: beyond a shadow of a doubt
cards.uzDef: Hech qanday shubha qoldirmasdan, to'liq ishonch bilan.

cards.ex: His contradictory statements only served to muddy the waters further.
cards.exUz: Uning zid bayonotlari vaziyatni yanada chalkashtirib yubordi.
cards.uzDef: Vaziyatni chalkashtirib, tushunishni qiyinlashtirmoq.

cards.ex: For the sake of argument, let's say that you're right.
cards.exUz: Bahs uchun, deylik, siz haqsiz.
cards.uzDef: Faqat bahslashish maqsadida yoki bir fikrni tekshirish uchun.

cards.ex: I took it as read that everyone knew about the meeting.
cards.exUz: Men hamma uchrashuv haqida biladi deb o'yladim.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsani haqiqat deb qabul qilish, isbot talab qilmaslik.

cards.ex: The exact amount of funding remains a contentious point between the two parties.
cards.exUz: Moliyalashtirishning aniq miqdori ikki tomon o'rtasida bahsli nuqta bo'lib qolmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Odamlar o'rtasida kelishmovchilikka sabab bo'ladigan muhim nuqta.

cards.ex: Reading between the lines, it's clear that she's not happy with the situation.
cards.exUz: Satrlar orasini o'qisak, uning vaziyatdan mamnun emasligi aniq.
cards.uzDef: So'zlar bilan aytilmagan ma'nolarni tushunishga harakat qilish.

cards.ex: We proceeded on the assumption that everyone would agree.
cards.exUz: Biz hamma rozi bo'ladi degan taxmin bilan davom etdik.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsani haqiqat deb qabul qilib, shunga asoslanib.

cards.ex: He used statistics to back up his argument about climate change.
cards.exUz: U iqlim o'zgarishi haqidagi dalillarini qo'llab-quvvatlash uchun statistikadan foydalangan.
cards.uzDef: Dalilni isbotlash uchun faktlar, misollar yoki dalillar keltirmoq.

cards.ex: Her line of reasoning was flawed, leading her to the wrong conclusion.
cards.exUz: Uning fikrlash usuli noto'g'ri bo'lib, uni noto'g'ri xulosaga olib keldi.
cards.uzDef: Bir xulosaga kelish uchun qilingan fikrlar ketma-ketligi.

cards.ex: His actions fly in the face of everything he claims to believe in.
cards.exUz: Uning harakatlari u e'tiqod qilaman degan hamma narsaga zid.
cards.term: to fly in the face of
cards.uzDef: Biror narsaga qat'iy zid bo'lmoq, ayniqsa umumiy e'tiqodga.

cards.ex: Saying that everyone should have access to healthcare begs the question of how it will be funded.
cards.exUz: Har bir inson sog'liqni saqlash xizmatidan foydalanishi kerak deyish, uning qanday moliyalashtirilishi savolini tug'diradi.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsa haqiqat deb qabul qilinadi, lekin isbot talab qilinadi.

cards.ex: I think we've got our wires crossed; I never agreed to that.
cards.exUz: Menimcha, biz chalkashtirib yubordik; men bunga hech qachon rozi bo'lmaganman.
cards.uzDef: Noto'g'ri tushunish yoki xatolikka yo'l qo'ymoq.

cards.ex: He's a strong proponent of renewable energy.
cards.exUz: U qayta tiklanadigan energiya manbalarining qat'iy tarafdori.
cards.uzDef: Biror g'oya, taklif yoki harakatni qo'llab-quvvatlash.

cards.ex: I have to take issue with your claim that the policy is effective.
cards.exUz: Sizning siyosat samarali degan da'voingizga norozilik bildirishim kerak.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsaga qarshi chiqish, unga rozi bo'lmaslik.

cards.ex: The crux of the matter is whether we can afford it.
cards.exUz: Masalaning mohiyati shundaki, bizning bunga qurbimiz yetadimi.
cards.uzDef: Muammoning eng muhim yoki asosiy qismi.

cards.ex: She made a compelling argument for why we should invest in education.
cards.exUz: U nima uchun ta'limga sarmoya kiritishimiz kerakligi haqida ishonchli dalil keltirdi.
cards.uzDef: E'tiroz bildirish qiyin bo'lgan kuchli va ishonarli dalil.

cards.ex: The new evidence could tip the scales in his favor.
cards.exUz: Yangi dalillar uning foydasiga ustunlik qilishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Yakuniy natijaga ta'sir ko'rsatmoq, bir tomonga og'dirmoq.

cards.ex: She put forward a proposal to improve working conditions.
cards.exUz: U ish sharoitlarini yaxshilash bo'yicha taklif ilgari surdi.
cards.uzDef: G'oya, reja yoki dalilni taklif qilmoq, taqdim etmoq.

cards.ex: I agreed to help on the understanding that I wouldn't be held responsible.
cards.exUz: Men javobgar bo'lmasligim sharti bilan yordam berishga rozi bo'ldim.
cards.uzDef: Kelishuv sharti sifatida, biror narsaga asoslanib.

cards.ex: He raised an objection to the proposed changes.
cards.exUz: U taklif qilingan o'zgarishlarga e'tiroz bildirdi.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsaga rozi emasligini rasman aytmoq, e'tiroz bildirmoq.

cards.ex: It stands to reason that if you study hard, you'll do well on the exam.
cards.exUz: Agar yaxshi o'qisangiz, imtihondan yaxshi o'tishingiz mantiqan to'g'ri.
cards.uzDef: Mantiqan to'g'ri va kutilgan bo'lmoq.

cards.ex: Let's get down to brass tacks – how much will this cost?
cards.exUz: Keling, asl mohiyatga o'taylik – bu qancha turadi?
cards.term: to get down to brass tacks
cards.uzDef: Muhokamaning asosiy faktlariga yoki haqiqiy masalaga o'tmoq.

cards.ex: By all accounts, the new manager is doing a great job.
cards.exUz: Hamma aytishicha, yangi menejer ajoyib ish qilyapti.
cards.uzDef: Hamma aytganidek, umumiy fikrga ko'ra.

cards.ex: For the most part, I agree with your assessment.
cards.exUz: Asosan, men sizning bahoingizga qo'shilaman.
cards.uzDef: Umuman olganda, ko'p hollarda.

cards.ex: We need to consider the merits and demerits of both options.
cards.exUz: Biz har ikki variantning yaxshi va yomon tomonlarini ko'rib chiqishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsaning ijobiy va salbiy tomonlari.

cards.ex: A question mark hangs over the future of the project.
cards.exUz: Loyiha kelajagi savol ostida qolmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsa haqida noaniqlik yoki shubha borligini anglatadi.
